propositions: Live DC harness must render representative rich-text bodies (heading, bold, code macro) via Jira's real API and assert rendered HTML through ?expand=renderedFields, not just wiki source.
State-based echo-safety must hold end-to-end: a converged rich body pushed via the codec, when re-read by a second reconcile pass, must decode unchanged so no re-push occurs (inbound=0).

Both-sides concurrent edits must resolve with local-wins behavior: when rebar-side AND Jira-side both edit the description before the next pass, rebar's value lands and a deduped outbound-field-conflict alert is raised (remote value recorded, not destroyed).
InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text must be pinned by a cross-repo contract test so breaking changes to its signature or ADF-handling behavior fail before the sibling agentic-dev-platform repo breaks.

Inbound differ must apply codec-aware echo-suppression for rich-text: Jira's echoed wire form must be recognized as unchanged when it matches the local body's landed map_fields_to_remote form, symmetric to outbound _baseline_form_matches.
